entities.name: Skule
entities.description: Wizard from Golthonor on Corondor during the Time of Legends, a mage from Balthesa murdered by his spellsquire Xarl.

entities.name: Xarl
entities.description: Skule's spellsquire who betrayed him to Mandek Ironfist and murdered him.

entities.name: Mandek Ironfist
entities.description: Warlord to whom Xarl betrayed Skule.

entities.name: Serra Angel Trine
entities.description: Angel summoned and bound by Skule under duress.

entities.name: Enslavement of Trine
entities.description: A 326-year period of terror on Corondor in which thousands, if not millions, were slain.

entities.name: Golthonor
entities.description: Region of Corondor Skule came from.

events.summary: Skule meets young Xarl and takes him on as a spellsquire.
events.quote: who met Xarl as a young boy, and took him on as a spellsquire.

events.summary: Xarl betrays Skule to the warlord Mandek Ironfist.
events.quote: years later, Xarl betrayed Skule to the warlord Mandek Ironfist .

events.summary: Xarl forces Skule to summon the Serra Angel Trine, then murders him right after the binding.
events.quote: Skule was murdered by Xarl immediately after binding the angel.
